decision.decision: We can't fill this order yet. Classic Bulldog Tee CC-TEE-WHITE in size S is out of stock (0 on hand), and our printer, Bulldog Print Co, won't ship anything new until overdue invoice 501 ($840.00) is paid. Accounting filed payment request #1 for $840.00 and it needs your approval. Once it's paid, Accounting will order 1 x CC-TEE-WHITE S from Bulldog Print Co at the $8.00 unit cost. Customer Service saved a draft apology to Tauhid Zaman (draft 1) that gives no firm date.
decision.reasoning: Today is 2026-08-31 in the shop system. Ticket 101 asks for 1 x CC-TEE-WHITE size S. Stock is 0 in Aisle B, so we're 1 short, and there are no purchase orders for it. The restock vendor is Bulldog Print Co (vendor 1), with a lead time of 5 days. They won't ship while invoice 501 is unpaid: $840.00, due 2026-08-28, 3 days overdue, described as 'Rush reprint CC-TEE-WHITE S'. Checking holds $3,400.00 and no other requests are waiting. Paying #1 leaves $2,560.00. That still covers the $2,400.00 rent on lease 1 (due 2026-09-02, no payment request filed yet) and the $8.00 restock order, leaving $152.00. Cash covers everything, but the margin is thin and the shop has no money coming in. The tee lists at $28.00 against a cost of $8.00. Because the shirt can only be ordered after the invoice is paid, it can't arrive before 2026-09-05. That date only holds if the invoice is paid and the order placed today.
next_steps: Owner: approve payment request #1 ($840.00 for invoice 501). Approving it makes the payment automatically, which unblocks Bulldog Print Co.

Rent first: the $2,400.00 rent on lease 1 is due 2026-09-02 and has no payment request yet. It should be filed and approved through the rent ticket, and comes before any spending beyond the $840.00 bill and the $8.00 order.

Re-run ticket 101 once the invoice is paid. Accounting should check that the 'Rush reprint CC-TEE-WHITE S' invoice doesn't already cover printed stock. If it doesn't, Accounting files the order for 1 x CC-TEE-WHITE S from vendor 1 ($8.00) for approval.

When the order is placed, the expected arrival is the order date plus 5 days. Customer Service should then draft a follow-up to Tauhid Zaman with that date, and Inventory should reserve the unit when it arrives.
Owner: review draft 1 (the apology to Tauhid Zaman) and send it if it reads well. It makes no firm promise.
